次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Players slide heavy stones across ice toward a circular target. Teammates sweep the ice in front of a moving stone. Stones closer to the center can earn points.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Two wrestlers face each other in a round ring. You lose if you step outside or touch the ground with anything except your feet. This traditional Japanese sport has very large athletes.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this Japanese martial art, players wear thick jackets and belts. They try to throw or hold down their opponent. A perfect throw can win the match with an ippon.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Players wear protective armor and hold bamboo swords in this Japanese martial art. They strike allowed areas while showing proper spirit and form. A metal face guard protects the head.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This martial art is strongly linked to Okinawa. Students practice punches, kicks, and blocks, often in white uniforms. Its name means empty hand, showing that the body can be used without weapons.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Two fighters wear padded gloves and compete inside a ring. They strike with their fists but cannot kick. A match may end when one fighter cannot rise before the count finishes.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Two players wear masks and protective clothing while fighting with thin sporting swords. They try to touch the opponent in allowed areas. Foil, epee, and sabre are its three weapon types.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Players use a bow to send arrows toward a distant target. The target has colored rings, with the highest score in the middle. It is also an Olympic sport.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this Japanese martial art, people shoot arrows with a very long bow. The grip is below the bow's center. Correct posture and the whole movement are important, not only hitting the target.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Runners cover a very long distance in this road race. It is much longer than a school sports-day race. The official full distance is forty-two point one nine five kilometers.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this race, teammates take turns running different sections. A small baton is usually passed from one runner to the next. The team's final runner crosses the finish line.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this event, athletes run toward a horizontal bar and jump over it. They land on a thick mat. The bar is raised as competitors clear greater heights.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Athletes run along a straight path and jump from a takeoff board. They land in a sand pit. The winner is the person who travels the greatest distance through the air.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this event, athletes carry a long flexible pole while running. They plant it in a box and rise over a high bar. A thick mat catches them afterward.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Athletes stand in a small circle holding a heavy metal ball. They push it from near their neck using one hand. The goal is to send it as far as possible.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
An athlete runs forward carrying a long pointed object. It is thrown over the shoulder into an open field. The object must land correctly for the distance to count.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this running event, athletes must clear several barriers along the track. They try to keep their speed while jumping over each one. Knocking one down does not always mean disqualification.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This race combines three different sports in one event. Competitors begin in the water, then ride bicycles, and finally run. The time spent changing between activities also counts.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this swimming stroke, both arms move together in front of the chest. The legs make a frog-like kick. Swimmers face downward and lift their heads to breathe.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this swimming stroke, your face usually stays above the water. You lie on your back and move your arms one after another. In races, swimmers begin from inside the pool.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This swimming stroke uses both arms together over the water. The legs stay close and make a dolphin-like kick. Its English name is also the name of a winged insect.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this swimming stroke, the arms reach forward one after another while the legs make small quick kicks. Swimmers usually turn the head sideways to breathe. It is commonly used in freestyle races.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Athletes jump from a board or high platform into a pool in this sport. They may turn in the air before entering. A clean entry with little splash helps their score.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Swimmers perform planned movements in a pool with music. They must control their bodies above and below the water. This sport was formerly widely known as synchronized swimming.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
You use a board for this ocean sport. After paddling out, you wait for a suitable wave. Then you stand on the board and ride the wave toward shore.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this snow sport, you attach a long narrow board to each foot. Many people hold poles for balance. You can slide down mountain slopes or travel across snowy ground.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
For this winter sport, both feet are attached to one wide board. You stand sideways as you slide down a snowy slope. Skilled riders can jump and turn in the air.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Athletes move across ice while music plays. Their performances include jumps, spins, and steps. Judges give scores for both technical skills and the quality of the whole performance.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Athletes wear skates with long blades and race on ice. In its long-track form, they usually compete in pairs around an oval. The fastest time decides the winner.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Athletes slide down a steep ramp on two long boards. They fly through the air before landing on a snowy slope. Both distance and style contribute to the score.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A team pushes a heavy sled before jumping inside it. They race down a narrow ice track with steep turns. The sled has a covered body and a steering system.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This activity uses a short board with four small wheels. Riders push against the ground with one foot. They can perform tricks by jumping, turning, and sliding along rails.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Climbers solve short routes on low walls or rocks without ropes. Thick mats protect the ground below. They use small holds and careful body movements to reach the top.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this activity, a person sits on an animal's back and guides it. The rider uses reins, legs, and balance. The animal is a horse, and a saddle often supports the rider.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Athletes perform flowing movements with music on a floor. They use objects such as ribbons, hoops, balls, and clubs. Flexibility, control, and artistic expression are important in this sport.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Athletes bounce on a tightly stretched surface supported by springs. They can turn and twist high in the air. The surface sends them upward again when they land.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Two teams hold opposite ends of a long rope. Each team pulls to move the other across a line. Working together matters more than pulling at different times.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Teams throw many small soft balls toward a basket raised high on a pole. When time is up, the balls inside are counted. This is common at Japanese school sports days.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Two people stand side by side and tie their nearest legs together. They must run as one pair. If their steps do not match, they may fall over.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Players throw a ball at members of the other team. Those hit under the rules must leave the inner playing area. Catching the ball instead of being hit helps you stay in.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
One player chases the others in this simple game. The others run away to avoid being touched. When someone is caught, that person may become the next chaser.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
One person closes their eyes and counts while the others move away. The others choose secret places and stay quiet. The first person then tries to find everyone.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
One player faces away while the others approach. When that player suddenly turns around, everyone must stop moving. The game's Japanese chant mentions a round doll falling over.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Two or more people show hand shapes at the same time. A closed fist, an open hand, and two raised fingers are used. Each shape beats one other shape and loses to another.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Players take turns saying words in this Japanese word game. Each word must begin with the final sound of the previous word. A word ending in the sound n normally loses.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
You loop a piece of string around your fingers for this activity. Moving your fingers changes the shape. Two people can pass the string between their hands while making new patterns.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Japanese toy has a wooden handle and a ball joined by a string. You swing the ball and catch it in small cups. A pointed tip can also enter the ball's hole.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this activity, a small toy balances on a pointed end while moving quickly around itself. A string can help start it. The challenge is to keep it upright and turning.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
You take a light object made of paper or cloth outside on a windy day. A long string keeps it connected to your hand. The wind lifts it into the sky.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this traditional Japanese new-year game, players use flat wooden paddles. They hit a small feathered object back and forth without a net. A missed return may lead to ink marks on the face.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A player covers their eyes in this Japanese game. They place separate eyes, a nose, and a mouth onto a blank face. Everyone laughs when the finished face looks strange.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Players move pieces along a path on a board. A roll of the dice usually decides how many spaces to move. Special spaces may send you forward, backward, or make you wait.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Cards are spread across the floor or a table. One person reads a clue while the others search. The players quickly take the card that matches the words they hear.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This collection contains one Japanese poem from each of one hundred poets. It is also used for a card game. Players hear a poem's beginning and race to take its ending.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Two players move pointed wooden pieces on a nine-by-nine board. Each tries to trap the other's king. Captured pieces can return to the board as part of the capturing player's army.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Two players place black and white stones on the intersections of a grid. They try to surround territory and capture stones. Once placed, stones do not move unless they are captured.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Two players face each other on a board with sixty-four squares. Their pieces include kings, queens, and knights. The goal is to put the opponent's king in checkmate.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Two players place flat black-and-white discs on a board. Trapping the opponent's discs between your own changes their color. Having more discs of your color at the end wins.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Two players place stones of different colors on a grid. Unlike a game about surrounding territory, they want a straight line. The first to connect five stones usually wins.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Cards lie face down on a table in this memory game. On each turn, you reveal two cards. Matching pairs can be kept, so remembering earlier cards helps you win.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Players remove matching pairs from their hands and draw cards from a neighbor. One special card has no partner. The person left holding that card at the end loses.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this card game, certain middle-numbered cards begin rows for each suit. Players extend the rows upward or downward one number at a time. The starting number comes between six and eight.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this card-game family, players try to win with strong combinations or clever betting. A flush and a full house are examples of hands. Sometimes a convincing bluff beats better cards.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this card game, you try to reach a total close to twenty-one without going over. Number cards keep their values. Face cards count as ten, while an ace can have two possible values.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This game usually has four players drawing and discarding tiles. They build matching groups and a pair to complete a hand. Its tiles include circles, bamboo, numbers, winds, and dragons.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Each player has a card with numbers arranged in a grid. A caller announces numbers chosen at random. Completing a required line lets a player shout the name of this game.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A picture is cut into many small pieces with unusual edges. You fit them together by matching colors and shapes. Finishing all the connections reveals the complete picture.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
You solve written clues and put words into a grid. Some words go across, while others go down. Shared squares mean that crossing words must have the same letter there.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This number puzzle usually uses a nine-by-nine grid. Fill the empty squares with numbers from one to nine. Each row, column, and small three-by-three box must contain each number once.
